items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: I don’t know how good he would have been.

ctx.x: I don’t know how good he would have been. He probably would have been fine but —

He did sit in on a few early on. We interviewed Mona Hinton, Milt Hinton’s wife, together, and a couple others. And he probably — he was a very opinionated man, about his musical tastes, so if he didn’t like something he was not good at disguising it.
